context: A student doing teaching practicum debriefs with a senior
purpose: Teach: 羽/脚/坂/食い/漏れ/流さ/精度/実習

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先輩、今日の教育実習、坂の上の学校まで通うのが本当にきつくて、脚がもうパンパンです。
lines.en: Senpai, today's teaching practicum — commuting up to the school on the hill, my legs are completely worn out.
lines.style: Tired junior venting casually to senior mentor

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あの急な坂はね、最初は誰でもそう。私も実習生のころ毎朝ヒーヒー言ってたよ。
lines.en: That steep hill, yeah — everyone struggles at first. I was huffing every morning back when I was a student teacher too.
lines.style: Warm experienced teacher reassuring with a smile

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 授業の方も散々で、生徒の前で時間配分の見積もりに漏れがあって、最後バタバタになっちゃいました。
lines.en: The lesson was a disaster too — I had a gap in my time estimate in front of the students, and the end turned into chaos.
lines.style: Self-critical junior describing classroom failure honestly

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 時間の精度は経験で上がるから大丈夫。それより、生徒の反応はちゃんと見られてた?
lines.en: Timing accuracy improves with experience, so don't worry. More importantly, were you able to read the students' reactions?
lines.style: Encouraging mentor redirecting focus to what matters

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それが、後ろの席の子が紙飛行機を飛ばしてて、羽の折り方まで凝ってて笑いそうになりました。
lines.en: Well, a kid in the back was flying paper airplanes — even the wing folds were elaborate, I almost burst out laughing.
lines.style: Slightly embarrassed junior recalling amusing classroom moment

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あはは、それは食い止めないとね。でも、笑いそうになるくらい余裕が出てきたってことだよ。
lines.en: Haha, you've gotta nip that in the bud. But the fact that you almost laughed means you're finally relaxing up there.
lines.style: Laughing mentor finding silver lining in mishap

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 後でその子に注意したら、『先生、声でかい』って逆に流されちゃって、もうへこみました。
lines.en: When I scolded him later, he just brushed me off with 'Teacher, you're too loud' — I was totally deflated.
lines.style: Demoralized junior sharing humbling student comeback

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ふふ、よくある話。指導日誌に書いて、明日また仕切り直しでいこう。お疲れさま。
lines.en: Hehe, classic. Write it in your teaching journal and start fresh tomorrow. Good work today.
lines.style: Gentle senior wrapping up with practical encouragement
